# `<e-alert>`

<!-- No screenshot found. Run the screenshots test to generate one. -->

Inline status banner for a message attached to a region of the page.

The static counterpart to a toast: nothing appears or disappears on a timer,
because an auto-dismissing message can be missed entirely between two panel
refreshes. Severity is carried by an icon, a border weight and — for
`error` — a hatch fill, never by color alone, so the banner still reads on a
grayscale panel.

Use `<e-result>` instead when the message *is* the page rather than a note
inside it.

> Source: [alert.ts](./alert.ts)

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'info'\|'success'\|'warning'\|'error'` | `'info'` | Severity preset; controls icon and border treatment. |
| `heading` | `string` | — | Bold leading line. Omit for a single-line banner. |
| `closable` | `boolean` | — | Renders a dismiss button. |
| `no-icon` | `boolean` | — | Suppresses the leading status icon. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `e-close` | `CustomEvent<{value: string}>` | Fired when the dismiss button is activated. `value` is the heading, or the banner's text when there is none. The host sets `hidden` on itself; remove it from the DOM if it should not come back. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _(default)_ | Body text of the banner. |
| `action` | Trailing action area (typically one `<e-button>` or `<e-link>`). |
